title: BaRISTA: Brain Scale Informed Spatiotemporal Representation of Human Intracranial Neural Activity
primary_outputs: Per-subject ROC-AUC and multi-seed aggregate for channel-, parcel- and lobe-level models under the same nonoverlapping train/validation/test windows.
Reproduce chronological-fold sensitivity for speech/sentence tasks and distinguish it from random-split performance.
